text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation and removal of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation and removal of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Attachment 1 to the report (October 2, 2025) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation
